# T-1: Define freshness scan policy

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add a reusable generic directory-boundary policy for freshness source traversal so excluded directories do not consume bounded traversal budgets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Excluded boundaries are skipped before recursion and file counting.
- Included-directory traversal retains limit and unreadable-path reporting.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the policy in the file-tree traversal domain and use a dedicated class for meaningful policy data.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests exercise the policy through FileTreeWalker or freshness traversal with a small maxFiles budget.
